lines.en: Marco, when we walked into the screen, the film had already begun, and everyone had gone silent.
lines.pt: Marco, quando entramos na sala, o filme já tinha começado, e todos já tinham ficado em silêncio.

lines.en: I remember. The lights had been turned off, and a man in front had fallen asleep.
lines.pt: Eu lembro. As luzes tinham sido apagadas, e um homem na frente tinha adormecido.

lines.en: Yes! He had been snoring for ten minutes before somebody asked him to stop.
lines.pt: Sim! Ele estava roncando havia dez minutos antes de alguém pedir que parasse.

lines.en: And the usher had brought a torch, but its battery had died.
lines.pt: E o lanterninha tinha trazido uma lanterna, mas a bateria dela tinha acabado.

lines.en: So we found our seats in the dark. Someone had left a coat on mine.
lines.pt: Então achamos nossos lugares no escuro. Alguém tinha deixado um casaco no meu.

lines.en: I had expected a boring story, but the main actor had already won me over.
lines.pt: Eu esperava uma história chata, mas o ator principal já tinha me conquistado.

lines.en: Really? The director had made only two films before this one, I think.
lines.pt: Sério? O diretor tinha feito só dois filmes antes deste, acho.

lines.en: Yes, and critics had praised both of them, so I had high hopes.
lines.pt: Sim, e os críticos tinham elogiado os dois, então eu tinha grandes expectativas.

lines.en: By the interval, the audience had laughed so much that the actors had to pause.
lines.pt: No intervalo, o público tinha rido tanto que os atores precisaram parar.

lines.en: Afterwards, we realised nobody had moved from their seats during the final scene.
lines.pt: Depois, percebemos que ninguém tinha saído do lugar durante a cena final.

lines.en: That says a lot! Let’s come back next week, and this time we will arrive early.
lines.pt: Isso diz muito! Vamos voltar na semana que vem, e desta vez chegaremos cedo.

facts.big: had begun / had been turned off / had been snoring
facts.label: Past perfect para cenas anteriores
facts.sub: Já tinha: had + particípio. Estava havia: had been + -ing. Tinha sido: had been + particípio.

facts.label: Já tinha começado
facts.sub: Had begun descreve o cenário antes de você chegar: The film had already begun. O particípio de begin é begun, não began. Em português, “já tinha começado”. Use with already para reforçar.

facts.label: Tinha adormecido
facts.sub: Had fallen asleep descreve um estado anterior: A man had fallen asleep. O particípio de fall é fallen. Use esse tempo para explicar o que você encontrou quando chegou a um lugar.

facts.label: Estava fazendo havia
facts.sub: Had been + -ing mostra uma ação que durava antes de outro momento: He had been snoring for ten minutes. Em português, “estava roncando havia dez minutos”. É past perfect contínuo, permitido no B2.

facts.label: Passivo
facts.sub: Had been + particípio descreve o que foi feito antes: The lights had been turned off. Em português, “tinham sido apagadas”. Use para falar de coisas, não de quem fez a ação.

pages.title: A night at an old cinema · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday night in the West End of Glasgow. An old cinema glows at the end of a wet street. Carla and Marco are standing under a red umbrella. They saw a film here last month, and they still talk about it. Nothing had gone as planned that night. Carla begins to describe the scene they found.

“Marco, when we walked into the screen, the film had already begun, and everyone had gone silent.” says Carla. “I remember. The lights had been turned off, and a man in front had fallen asleep.” says Marco. “Yes! He had been snoring for ten minutes before somebody asked him to stop.” says Carla.

paragraphs: “Afterwards, we realised nobody had moved from their seats during the final scene.” says Marco. “That says a lot!
